# Canonical Story baselines

`archive-witness/` contains the 24 canonical Markdown records from the former
structural witness-mystery seed scenario (scope arc.truth/milestone.disclosure,
composition depth, protect/challenge). They are fixed author-provided input
data for focused-revision tests, not an execution certificate. No Generation
checkpoint, specialist receipt, approval, session, native verdict, or Review
is copied. Tests create fresh Git baselines and validate actual canonical
records before authorizing a new Turn.
